events.name: Vancouver Canucks at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Chris Kreider and Filip Chytil got New York off to a strong start in the first period and the Rangers held on to beat the Vancouver Canucks 4-3 on Wednesday night for their third straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kreider, Chytil lead Rangers to 4-3 win over Canucks

video.headline: Mika Zibanejad's late goal key in Rangers' win over the Canucks

headlines.description: — Captain Jamie Benn broke a scoreless tie 23 seconds into the second period of his 1,001st career game, and the Dallas Stars beat the Minnesota Wild 4-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Benn breaks scoreless tie early in 2nd, Stars top Wild 4-1
